title: Banda Singh’s Faith in the Guru and the Opening of Episode 31

blocks.text: This transition page completes Banda Singh's pledge of obedience by emphasizing that he must act under the collective Will of the Khalsa rather than private ambition. His prayer asks not for arbitrary power but for help that remains aligned with the Guru and the Panth in moments of trial.

The page then opens the next episode by testing that promise in practical form. Banda Singh is told to gather an assembly of five Singhs, and the story immediately connects faith, sangat, and provision through the arrival of resources identified as the Guru's dasvandh.

Because of that turn, the page belongs to both the close of one vow and the beginning of another proof. It shows Banda's fidelity being measured in public discipline, communal consultation, and visible support.
